intended_object: The reflexive-transitive closure of a Kripke frame: the frame with the same worlds whose accessibility relation is the reflexive-transitive closure R* of the original relation R. Inferred from the name, the notation F^*, and the lemmas after it (reflexive, transitive, contains R).
explanation: The body keeps the set of worlds (the nonemptiness instance is found automatically) and replaces the relation with `Relation.ReflTransGen F.Rel`, which is Mathlib's reflexive-transitive closure. That is exactly the standard reflexive-transitive closure of a Kripke frame. Mathlib has no Kripke frames, so it has no counterpart for this frame-level construction; the relation itself is Mathlib's `Relation.ReflTransGen`, used here directly. The frame structure belongs to the library, so the definition is stated at its natural generality.
